window_note: Request counts come from `journalctl -u loopskill-api` uvicorn access lines on wisechef-hq. Journal retention on the host reaches back only to 2026-09-12T14:00Z (10.2 days, 148,296 requests, 1,439 distinct ip/method/path/status tuples); no older access log survives (syslog rotation unreadable to the deploy user, Caddy has no access log). So used_30d for HTTP routes is a lower-bound-by-window: a route with 0 here had 0 hits in the last ~10 days of prod traffic. Install/telemetry/fleet figures below are true 30-day DB counts (moneypath_loopskill_used30d.py, read-only psql over SSH). Routes are matched to access-log paths with Starlette first-match semantics against the registered route table; HEAD is folded into GET; requests for unregistered paths (scanner noise like /api/.env) are ignored. Internal IPs (WR_SERVER_PUBLIC_IP + WR_KNOWN_INTERNAL_IPS + loopback) are excluded from used_30d_organic only. No user identifiers, IPs, API keys, or query strings are stored in this file.
